inst.title: Aqulify – installation on Linux
inst.noRoot: Do not run it as root! Start it as your own user (it will ask for the sudo password for the packages).
inst.unknownDistro1: Unknown distribution (%s). Required: C/C++20 compiler, cmake, pkg-config, libpipewire-0.3 and fftw3 (float) development packages;
inst.unknownDistro2: for the app window: gtk3 and webkit2gtk-4.1 (or 4.0) development packages.
inst.noWebkit: The WebKitGTK package was not installed: the interface will open in a browser.
inst.noPwCli: pw-cli was not found. Is your sound system really PipeWire?
inst.guiFail1: The app window (WebKitGTK) interface did not build (details: build/gui-build.log).
inst.guiFail2: Fallback: the app window of a Chromium-based browser, or if there is none, the default browser.
inst.guiFail3: Fix: install the gtk3 and webkit2gtk-4.1 development packages, then run ./install.sh again.
inst.legacy: Removing the previous AetherAudio installation (the settings are carried over)...
inst.step4: [4/6] Setting up automatic start (systemd user service)...
inst.serviceOk: The engine is running and starts automatically at login.
inst.serviceFail: The systemd user service is not available. Start it manually: %s &
inst.desktopComment: Parametric EQ, convolver, crossfeed and true peak limiter for PipeWire with a live 3D waterfall analyzer
inst.menuOk: In the menu and on the desktop: Aqulify
inst.defaultExplain: Application audio goes through Aqulify when "Aqulify" is the output device.
inst.legacyDefault: The previous AetherAudio was the default output: Aqulify takes over.
inst.askDefault: Set it as the default now? [y/N]
inst.defaultFail: That did not work; set it in the Sound settings (Output: Aqulify).
inst.defaultLater: You can select it later in the Sound settings (Output: Aqulify).
uninst.purged: Aqulify and its saved settings have been removed.
uninst.removed: Aqulify has been removed. (The settings were kept: ~/.config/aqulify — to delete them: ./uninstall.sh --purge)
